description: The dashboard window draws its own titlebar (tauri.conf.json sets decorations: false for it, see frontend/src/windows/dashboard/App.tsx's drag-region div) instead of relying on macOS's native close/minimize/zoom — these are the core window-plugin permissions its custom traffic-light buttons and drag handle need. Onboarding and Recovery are chromeless too (migrated 2026-09-01) but need only dragging, not the dashboard's hide/minimize/toggle-maximize traffic-light buttons — see capabilities/onboarding-recovery-drag.json. The pill is also draggable (2026-08-30) but has its own separate grant, capabilities/pill-drag.json — it needs only allow-start-dragging, not the hide/minimize/toggle-maximize this file grants for the dashboard's custom titlebar buttons.
